t: Building the Digital Corpus Callosum: Seamless Notebook Sync for Literate Programming
s: This article details the development and implementation of `pip.nbup()`, a Python function that automates the synchronization of Jupyter Notebooks from a working directory to a Git-managed template repository, including auto-pruning of the sync command itself.
sub: Automated Jupyter Notebook synchronization to Git repository
Development of `pip.nbup()` function for literate programming
Robust pathfinding and project root detection (using `flake.nix`)
Programmatic cleaning and auto-pruning of notebooks using `nbformat`
